inspiration: Creature progression by text: fungus_zombie.json gives several description variants for one undead as it changes, from dusted, to a stalk out of the skull, to a swollen balloon-like body (lines 6, 20, 37, 79). Recreate as one fungal walker with three visual stages.

One glyph per creature family: the mi-go entries use a fixed glyph and colour per variant (pink for the base type, red for a surgeon variant; mi-go.json lines 15-16, 67-68, 125-126). A strong silhouette can carry identity when the art is tiny.

Cheap lighting with paired tiles: tile_config.json lists lighting_*_light and lighting_*_dark tile ids (line 11). An atlas of two-tone tiles gives light and shadow without a shader. Recreate with a shader multiply pass instead of duplicated art if we want fewer tiles.
Fallback sheets: each tileset ships a fallback.png and a tall or alternate sheet for regions (gfx/ASCIITileset/fallback.png, gfx/Larwick_Overmap/overmap_tall.png). Good practice for missing art.

Whole-UI palettes as one file: data/raw/color_themes holds about 25 named themes (vintage, sun, blood moon, high-contrast and others), so the UI palette swaps in one step. Recreate with our own names and values.
Minimal UI sound set: two blips (move and error) mapped by id in soundset.json (data/sound/Menu_Sound_Test). A two-sound feedback pair covers navigation and rejection.
Credits as a file: data/mods/hunvre/credits.txt lists each third-party item with its licence (a CC BY 2.0 image, an OFL font). A model for our own credits file, whatever art we end up with.
Overmap region sheets: a separate tile sheet for the regional map view, distinct from the local map tiles. Relevant to our zone and world-map design.

briefs.label: Stalk-crowned fungal walker
briefs.why: A slow undead that changes over time reads as dread without gore. The growth stages tell the player how long the creature has been there.
briefs.keep: Three visual stages from dusted to overgrown; a fungal stalk growing from the head; a grey dust base colour.
briefs.change: A quadruped crawler instead of a shambling humanoid; crystal spore growths in our own colour; a different head silhouette.

briefs.label: Single-glyph horror
briefs.why: A creature identified by one symbol and a colour family stays readable at tiny sizes and in ASCII-style views.
briefs.keep: One fixed symbol per creature family; colour by variant (base, elite, surgeon-type); a strong silhouette at small size.
briefs.change: Our own symbol family (not the ampersand); a different colour story; a larger-scale silhouette for close-up art.

briefs.label: Lit-tile twin ladder
briefs.why: Paired light and dark tiles give a lit look for almost no cost, which suits a sprite sheet on a low budget.
briefs.keep: A light and dark twin for each entity; lighting handled by tile swap.
briefs.change: A shader multiply or per-sprite normal lighting instead of duplicated art; our own tone steps.

briefs.label: Region-map twin sheets
briefs.why: A separate tall sheet for the regional map, with a fallback sheet, handles many terrain types without one huge atlas.
briefs.keep: A normal and a tall sheet; a fallback sheet for missing art.
briefs.change: Our own terrain set and a hatch-pattern fallback instead of plain placeholder art.
